[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested tips for choosing running shoes for flat feet:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Look for shoes with good arch support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Choose shoes with a stable sole.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Look for shoes with a wide toe box to accommodate flat feet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Choose shoes with extra cushioning for shock absorption.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Consider buying shoes with custom insoles or orthotics to help support feet and correct pronation issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Try on shoes later in the day when feet may be swollen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Consider going to a specialty running shoe store for expert assistance.
